content.title: Los Angeles Lakers vs Orlando Magic Mar 24, 2025 Game Summary
content.text: Monday, March 24th, 2025 10:06 PMBy DICK SCANLON - Associated PressGame RecapORLANDO, Fla. (AP) Franz Wagner had 32 points and eight assists, Paolo Banchero added 30 points and seven rebounds and the Orlando Magic sent the Los Angeles Lakers to their third straight loss, 118-106 on Monday night.Luka Doncic scored 32 points and LeBron James added 24 points and eight assists for the Lakers, who have lost seven of their last 10.Anthony Black came off the bench and finished with 17 points, five rebounds and six assists for the Magic.Austin Reaves scored eight of his 17 points in the first quarter for the Lakers, who led by nine points late in the first half, but were outscored 34-18 in the third quarter.Lakers: With a third straight loss in the opener of a four-game trip, the Lakers (43-28) slipped into a tie for fourth place in the Western Conference with idle Memphis.Magic: Orlando (34-38) snapped a six-game home losing streak and remained eighth place in the Eastern Conference.After the Lakers had trimmed a 17-point deficit to seven with 5:40 remaining, Wagner and Banchero combined for Orlando's next 10 points, including six on layups, for a 110-98 lead with 3:19 left.The lowest scoring team in the NBA at 104.8 points per game, the Magic shot 49.4% overall, made 15 3-pointers and made just nine turnovers.The Lakers play at Indiana on Wednesday night. The Magic are at Charlotte on Tuesday night.---AP NBA: https://apnews.com/hub/NBAActivate NBA League Pass to watch games live and on demand.GAME INFOMonday, March 24, 202511:00 PMOfficialsMichael Smith, Brian Forte, Jacyn GobleLINESCORESTeamQ1Q2Q3Q4FinalLAL30301828106ORL26323426118TeamPITPFB PTSBIG LDBPTSTREBTOVTTOVPOTLAL4812914610115ORL4420173088110
